description: This file is a C header defining functions and constants for RSA signature verification in the RDM (RDK Download Manager) component, including error codes, cryptographic buffer sizes, and API declarations for signature verification functions.

methods.name: rdm_signature_verify
methods.description: Verifies the signature of an RDM package, with options to prepare files before verification.

methods.name: cpe_local_verify_file_signature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a local file using a provided public key and signature file.
